hypothesis: Native Qwen video temporal patches may improve contact selection relative to failed sheet/image presentations; improvement is unproven.
candidates: Exactly the original frozen V6 policy call2 collision_candidates, same original order and individual frozen stage2_v2 labeled tiles; no source/GT-based additions or window tuning.
model: Actual V6 saved Qwen3-VL-4B NF4 checkpoint, original device and generation configuration
question: Remove only the exact first sheet-layout sentence from original call2 prompt; retain remaining task/allowedIDs/JSON instructions and48 output tokens. One frozen helper prefix defines chronological video order and synthetic playback timestamps. No source physical FPS or PTS supplied to inference.

video.per_frame_resize: Same RGB/BICUBIC/32-multiple rounding formula as LocalVLM, using padded frame count for denominator
video.odd_padding: Processor repeats last frame, never creates a new candidate ID

causal_limit: This changes temporal pairing, presentation timestamps, prefix text and effective image/token allocation. It is a distinct representation hypothesis, not a pure single-factor packing ablation.
prediction: Accept only an offered frame parsed by frozen _json_object/_integer. Malformed, absent or out-of-offered answer falls back to unchanged V6 final uncapped-motion contact; log reason. No confidence threshold or posthoc choice.
other_fields: Copy V6 entry/side/space only for this contact diagnostic; do not claim complete model or end-to-end equivalence.

evaluation.references: Existing nine human_review_draft files with exact source SHA and native frame PTS bindings, evaluated after all9 predictions frozen
evaluation.report: Final V6 and candidate counts/errors, internal VLM reference selection, offered candidate coverage, gains/losses, fallback contribution, actual token/grid/runtime/VRAM
evaluation.advance_requires: At least one new contact correct vs V6, no prior correct lost, contact accuracy strictly improves, all nine calls complete and contract passes
evaluation.adoption: Not automatic. A passing diagnostic requires separately frozen complete pipeline, regression/resource/offline checks and additional independent evidence. Prior failed candidates are not revived.
evaluation.failure: Preserve all results and stop this hypothesis; no changing FPS/window/tiles/prompt/gate on these results. No ZIP or submission on failure.
